notes: Of 150 claims in the theme, most are framings without an external test (windows closing, eschatological or retrocausal passages, internal build plans, archive-specific observations). Searching went to the dated forecasts of #1632, #45, #615, #835, #1111 and #124. The disconfirmation of most weight is D-economy-W01: a vendor benchmark (Faro Index, July 2026) published accuracy by industry, separated from mention, before PRED-1632.A7 (registered 2026-09-20) said none would before 2027-12-31. Its fit is limited by the absence of an open sample and by the difference between claim-match accuracy and entity-resolution accuracy; the operator rules whether it meets the falsifier 'to the extent that publication covers'.
